comments: As of 2022/04/19, most of the data race cases are fixed, at least for those can be stability reproduced ones.

review_comments: Combine `handleFlags` and `handleRaceFlag` is better. Like add an int param for `handleFlags` to figure out how many args for this flag.

When the params are complex enough, I'd rather refactor the code to introduce some more complex packages like `flags` or even [spf13/cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra)
But I think I can still bear with the complexity.
Any way, it's just used as a quick and dirty script.
